guard:
SELECT cp.id, cp.name_en, cp.name_ar, cp.brand, cp.category, cp.tps_version, cp.created_at
    FROM canonical_products cp
    WHERE cp.category = 'appliance' AND cp.is_active AND cp.tps_version = '1.0'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normalized_product_observations n WHERE n.canonical_product_id = cp.id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tps_product_projection t WHERE t.canonical_id = cp.id)
